authority_mode.rule: Chosen and persisted at installation or session creation, outside the skill folder. Never silently switched during a network failure.

budgets.rule: Worst-case total can never exceed 50. A retry counts against the session ceiling. When a request's completion is uncertain it is recorded as unknown and never replayed to make a display green.

model_routing.selection_rule: The client explicitly selects the model, or their configured default applies. Recommendations are guidance only and are never a hidden prescription.

notes: Nonsecret reference defaults shipped with the skill. The runtime reads effective configuration from the authoritative store for the installation's chosen mode; nothing in this folder is mutable runtime state.
